claim: Room-over-room is a budget in Blood: 11 of 43 campaign maps have none and most have a handful. E1M1 reuses its one big ROR volume (s65, ceiling 504) as a slide carrier instead of spending another, and its casket s30 is slide-marked and stack-linked to s28 at once. Believed reason: two ROR volumes must not be in view together.
use: Plan few stacks and keep them out of each other's view; a stack can also carry a mechanism.
